The Expires field in the Details rail is defaultValue="2026-09-17" for every contract. On the Allbirds NDA it shows 17/09/2026 while the list and the public cover both say 6 Aug 2027. Bind to x.expires.

Typography around slot chips: '...of 12 Buchan Street, Christchurch , effective 21 Sep 2026 .' The .sa-slot chips are inline-block with horizontal margin, so a space lands before every following comma and full stop. Verified at 1:1 magnification and it is present on the client-facing contract too. Use margin-inline-start only, or a zero right margin plus letter-spacing.

The bulleted clause list in 'The work' renders with no bullet markers, in both the admin body and the public document, so four scope lines read as loose indented sentences. Restore list-style on .sa-doc-body ul li.

The builder loses the org and the deal. The live LinkedToPanel carries orgId, dealId and proposalId; the Details rail here shows Type, Expires, Created, Sent, Signed and 'From proposal' only. You cannot get from a contract to its client or its deal.

'Customise + send' has no home. The live builder has a Send-for-signature rail section with 'Email all pending (N)' plus a customise-and-send path (subject, message, cc/bcc). In the Public link rail, Revoke wraps onto its own row with the same visual weight as Copy and Open. A destructive action should not be the widest button in the group.

The draft state is the best thing on this page: unfilled slots render as amber chips carrying the readable slot name, with an inline warning that an empty slot ships to the signer as the placeholder. That is a genuine improvement on the live behaviour and should survive to production.

Same identical sparkline and same floating comma in the Reading column as the proposals list.
No Deal column and no sorting, same as the other two lists.

(Moodboard sign off), 'Art direction ...', 'Copy and pro...', 'Figma compo...', 'Han...', 'Campaign go...'. Verified at true 1280 with the real breakpoints applied. No search, no type filter, no sort. The live contract templates page has a permanent Type chip and a search over name/description, and t-c1 alone is 'used 14 times'; this shelf will not stay at eleven cards.

sales.summary:
Read the whole prototype (sales-artifacts.jsx 1,911 lines, plus data, kit and the 87KB stylesheet) against the reader map, then walked all 13 pages and every state at 1280, 375 and dark in Chrome, with DOM probes for touch targets, single-side borders, overflow, truncation and hover/focus parity.

The work is genuinely strong and none of it needs redesigning. The gantt editor, the delivery column on the schedules list, the proposal package page, the signature pad, the contract slots view and the "Where we are" page on the client schedule are all better than what is live. Zero single-side borders in the stylesheet, zero em or en dashes, no hover-only affordances (35 hover selectors against 32 focus selectors, the five "gaps" are just button variants covered by the base focus ring), and at 375 every interactive element measures 44px or more on every page I audited. Every verdict is FIX, not because the issues are small but because none of them require starting a page again.

FIRST, A VERIFICATION PROBLEM THAT AFFECTS THE SESSION NOTES. The preview harness's breakpoint rescoping is racy and fails silently. On roughly half my page loads sales-artifacts.css was never rescoped: __rescoped was false, the three max-width blocks were still live in the sheet, and because the real browser window is 656px wide all three fired at once. Every "1280" screenshot taken in that state is actually the 767px mobile stylesheet rendered inside a 1280-wide box. I only caught it when the client RACI matrix appeared to be a broken two-column stack; at a genuinely rescoped 1280 it is a correct five-column table. This means the session's claims of verifying at 1280 are unreliable, and it is why I re-checked every layout finding below with an explicit __rescoped assertion before screenshotting. Fix: make rescopeBreakpoints retry until sheet.cssRules is populated, and have the harness display the rescope state next to "stage 1280x900 at 49%" so a failure is visible rather than silent.

THE SIX BLOCKERS, ranked:
1. v-con signed. "Thank you, Nina. Your signature is recorded. We are waiting on 0 more." with "2 of 2 signed" sitting next to "FULLY SIGNED: Not yet" on the same cover. The last signer never sees the fully-signed state.
2. Cover titles across all three viewers and both builders. title.replace(orgName,'') then appending the org in green turns "Mahana Orchards ecommerce replatform" into "ecommerce replatform Mahana Orchards" and "Allbirds mutual non-disclosure agreement" into "mutual non-disclosure agreement Allbirds". The house naming convention leads with the client, so this breaks on nearly every real record, at 64px, on the first thing the client sees.
3. v-prop at 375. The value-anchor slide overflows and clips its comparison prices mid-number ("NZ$41,000 to NZ$6..."), so the slide's entire argument is the part that gets cut.
4. v-con read. The page tells an anonymous link-holder "That is you" and prints both signers' email addresses. The signer identity is guessed, not passed.
5. s-edit draft. The main panel renders completely blank, because view is initialised to a hardcoded section id that the draft schedule does not have. That is the state every new schedule starts in.
6. c-edit analytics. AVERAGE READ and TOTAL ATTENTION both read 0s directly above a visit list showing 3m 4s and 42s.

THREE SYSTEMIC DEFECTS, each one fix in the stylesheet:
- Flex containers with a column-gap wrapping mixed text and element children, which drops a space either side of punctuation and plurals: "14 views , 4 people" on two lists and both mobile cards, "Back to  proposal  s" on the templates page, "Compare all  3  side by side" and "Prepared  31 Aug 2026" on the client proposal, "33 % complete" on the client schedule, "9  slides" on template cards.
- .sa-field-l sets text-transform:capitalize, producing "Prepared For", "Valid Until", "One Off", "Row Type", "Start Week", and on the client-facing decision modal, "Your Name" and "Anything To Add".
- Hardcoded demo values that contradict the record they sit next to: the cover Effective/Valid-until inputs (fixed at 31/08/2026 and 15/09/2026 for every proposal), the contract Expires field (fixed at 17/09/2026, wrong for the Allbirds NDA by eleven months), and every audit-trail and decision timestamp stamped 9:12am or 2:41pm on the two screens whose whole value is chronology.

DATA-MODEL GAPS AGAINST THE READER MAP: the Deal column is gone from all three lists; Sent is gone from contracts; no list sorts at all, where the live DataTables sort five columns each; the contract builder has lost the org and deal links; the schedule builder has lost Effective and the whole Linked-to panel; proposalVariants.pricingNotesHtml is neither editable nor rendered; contract template bodies can no longer be edited now that the three shelves are one; and the live 16-type add-slide picker, the most content-heavy decision on the surface, is a toast.

ONE HONEST DISAGREEMENT WITH A STATED DECISION: promoting the derived "viewed" status into the same flow band as the stored ones makes the Sent tile read a hard 0 while two proposals are in fact shared, and the bands on both proposals and contracts omit a status that exists in the data (expired, cancelled), so the tiles sum to 5 while the counter says 6 of 6. The decision list claims this row is what finally makes every status reachable; it does the opposite for the two dead-end statuses it names.

The client portal shelves (cp-prop, cp-con, cp-sch) share one problem worth calling out together: each is a single full-width card on an otherwise empty page, with the same four-step spine repeated at the top of all three. They want to be one "Your papers" page with three sections, and the schedule card needs to say what "Blocked" means and what it needs from the client, since the blocked phase is client-owned.

Screenshots were reviewed in-session and not persisted to disk; every page entry ends with the deep-link query string that reproduces each state in the harness (e.g. ?page=v-con&state=signed&w=1280&bar=off).
